rule: Native receipt status and validation describe whether the bounded review action completed and its return is structurally usable. The reviewed target verdict remains separate in the detailed review artifacts.
review_owner_rule: A review dispatch closes resolved when the parent accepts the verified change-request list; FIX findings do not make the review action incomplete.
authority_notice: This normalization does not lower the Anime.js target blockers or imply ontology readiness.
